Neugebauer, co-founder and largest shareholder of Fermi Inc., disclosed that the company has dropped its lawsuit against him, which was filed to validate a 70% supermajority bylaw amendment, after a Texas Business Court ordered the company to produce documents and testimony explaining the rationale for the bylaw. general.title: Bakai Sees Hong Kong as Bridge to Central Asia
general.summary: Andreas Meletiou, CEO of Bakai Bank Hong Kong, says the lender chose Hong Kong for its strong links to Central Asia and its position as a leading global financial hub. He speaks on "Bloomberg: The China Show." (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Japan’s 10-Year Bond Sale Draws Solid Demand as Yields Top 3%
general.summary: Japan’s 10-year government bond auction Tuesday saw stronger demand than the 12-month average as elevated yields underpinned buying.

general.title: Ray Dalio Warns of US Debt Crisis Within Three Years
general.summary: Bridgewater Associates Founder Ray Dalio warns that the US is approaching the limits of its debt cycle, predicting a potential crisis within three years as spending outpaces revenue. He cautions that rising borrowing costs and weakening demand from key foreign buyers may squeeze lower-income borrowers first. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: India Set For First Rate Hike in Almost Four Years: Guide
general.summary: India’s central bank is poised to raise interest rates for the first time in nearly four years on Wednesday as rising inflation and a rupee near record lows force policymakers to shift gears.

general.title: US Senator McCormick on US-Japan Investment Opportunities
general.summary: US Republican Senator for Pennsylvania, Dave McCormick, discusses his visit to Japan, as he leads a delegation to discuss bilateral investment opportunities, after the US and Japan reached a $500B investment trade deal earlier this year. He speaks with Shery Ahn on "Bloomberg: The Asia Trade". (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: World Bank Lifts India GDP View, Says Asia’s Buffers Too Thin
general.summary: The World Bank on Tuesday raised its growth forecast for India, saying strength in industry and services will help the economy weather a weaker monsoon and elevated energy prices.

general.title: Higgsfield CEO on Growth, $1B Run-rate
general.summary: Alex Mashrabov, CEO of Video AI Start up Higgsfield, discusses the company's path to achieving generate annualised revenue of more than $1 billion, based on current performance. He also discusses the company's growth and business strategies for APAC markets. He speaks exclusively with Shery Ahn on "Bloomberg: The Asia Trade". (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: AI Video Startup Kling Picks Banks for $1 Billion-Plus IPO
general.summary: Kuaishou Technology’s Kling AI has picked banks for a Hong Kong initial public offering that could raise at least $1 billion, according to people familiar with the matter.

general.title: Vance Says Alaska Deal Will Proceed After Trump Warns Korea
general.summary: Vice President JD Vance said an Alaska natural gas project with South Korea will move forward even as Seoul said its participation remains conditional on the venture being economically viable — prompting a threat of trade retaliation from President Donald Trump.

general.title: More Price Risks Loom Over Philippines After Inflation Surge
general.summary: The Philippines is facing a slew of price risks after inflation surged past economists’ estimates in September, backing the case for the central bank to further raise its policy rate.

general.title: Chalmers: Higher Bond Yields Will Pressure Australia Budget
general.summary: Jim Chalmers, Australian Treasurer, says higher global bond yields will put pressure on the Australian budget as the widespread selloff pushes debt refinancing costs higher. He speaks with Haidi Stroud-Watts and Shery Ahn on Bloomberg: The Asia Trade. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Banks Chase Risky Chip Loans in Asia’s $8.2 Trillion AI Buildout
general.summary: The next wave of artificial intelligence debt financing is taking off in Asia.

general.title: Bangkok Braces for Floods Before Global Finance Chiefs Gather
general.summary: Bangkok is preparing for possible flooding as more than 15,000 delegates are due to arrive for the annual meetings of the International Monetary Fund and World Bank Group.

general.title: Gold Edges Lower as Strong Dollar, Yields Weigh on Fed Rate Path
general.summary: Gold edged lower, as traders weighed the impact of a stronger dollar and higher Treasury yields on the Federal Reserve’s path for interest rates.

general.title: Australia’s Consumer Confidence Tumbles Further After Rate Hike
general.summary: Australia’s consumer confidence declined further in October, driven by the Reserve Bank’s interest-rate increase and ongoing pressure from fuel prices, with households reporting growing unease over the jobs outlook.

general.title: AI researcher warns 'we are racing to build and grow our own adversary' in NYC hearing
general.summary: The leading AI labs facing intensifying scrutiny over their safety and security practices.

general.title: Stocks Advance as Bonds Rebound and Oil Falls: Markets Wrap
general.summary: The S&P 500 is set to move closer to its first record high since August in a broad advance in global stocks as bonds climbed and weaker oil prices helped ease worries over inflation.

general.title: Oracle 2025 Health Breach Compromised Data of 20 Million People
general.summary: A cybersecurity breach last year of Oracle Corp.’s healthcare unit compromised personal information belonging to nearly 20 million people, according to information released by the Texas attorney general.
